ov: 360 هو فيلم دراما وإثارة تم إنتاجه في فرنسا والمملكة المتحدة والبرازيل والنمسا والولايات المتحدة بطولة ريتشل وايز وجود لود.
plotEn: 360 is a 2011 drama thriller film directed by Fernando Meirelles and written by Peter Morgan as a loose adaptation of  Arthur Schnitzler's 1897 play Reigen. The film stars an ensemble cast of Anthony Hopkins, Ben Foster, Rachel Weisz, Jude Law and other international actors. Following the stories of couples and their sexual encounters, 360 was selected to open the 2011 London Film Festival. Magnolia Pictures released the film on video on demand on 29 June 2012 and was released  in United States
